description: Update a draft, scheduled, or failed article. Published articles cannot be edited. Set scheduled_date to schedule, or pass an empty string to unschedule back to draft. Markdown supported: # / ## / ### headings, **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, [links](url), bullet/numbered lists, > blockquotes, images via ![caption](url) (uploaded to X automatically), and embedded posts by placing an x.com status URL on its own line. Fenced code blocks are preserved as plain text (X articles have no code formatting).

content_markdown.description: New markdown body (replaces the existing content)

cover_image_url.description: New cover image URL (empty string removes the cover)

scheduled_date.description: ISO 8601 datetime to (re)schedule, or empty string to unschedule

name: opentweet_update_article
